event_records.description: The period leading up to the January meeting begins. The precept is on the agenda for formal adoption.

kettlewell_parish_council.name: Kettlewell Parish Council
kettlewell_parish_council.persona_brief:
You are Kettlewell Parish Council.
The council is a body of elected members. Its standing orders require formal adoption of the precept at the January meeting. The council has a chairperson and a clerk. The precept for next year has been prepared but not yet formally adopted.

resolution.question: Will Kettlewell parish council formally adopt next year's precept at its January meeting, as its standing orders require?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Kettlewell Parish Council formally adopted next year's precept at its January meeting before the hard cutoff of 2027-01-21T22:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
